drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:set-up-business-accounts-and-connections row: steps list-connections, check-youtube, record-the-stage); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:set-up-business-accounts-and-connections for Sunrise Bakery: check Stripe, Instagram, YouTube and the mail domain sunrise-bakery.example, and tell me what is still missing."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No YouTube connection check tool is in the live catalog.
values.chosen: Submitted connected false and told the owner to reconnect the channel in the app's connections list.
values.evidence: The youtube row of tool:list-every-connection answered connected false.

values.undecided: The owner did not name a DNS host.
values.chosen: Submitted a gap: DNS host unknown, so the exact record-entry screen could not be given.
values.evidence: The owner's answer in this step.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Pour the example checklist rows into the checklist you already keep (see pour), or make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps from them.
2. Write record:business-setup:facts with workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion; include channels, email_sending_domain, country_code, seller_return_url and seller_refresh_url.

3. Say "Run workflow:set-up-business-accounts-and-connections". It lists every connection, checks the Stripe seller, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, adds the email sending domain and hands you its DNS records to add at your own DNS host, then makes the sending key and keeps it in the vault by name.
4. Open the Stripe onboarding link yourself, add the DNS records, reconnect any channel that answered not connected, and run it again; read record:setup-stage:accounts for what is left.

worked_examples.title: YouTube is not connected: the step reports a gap
worked_examples.given: Read from the step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: it reads the youtube row of the list-connections answer instead of calling a tool. Synthetic row: {"name":"youtube","kind":"service","connected":false}. The step says to submit connected false and a gap.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"connected":false} with the gap "No YouTube connection check tool is in the live catalog (send-a-post-to-youtube needs an account id). Reconnect the YouTube channel in the app's connections list."

worked_examples.title: The sending domain is added and its DNS records are kept
worked_examples.given: Read from the step and tools/email-sending-domains (the tool only asks Resend to verify, answering {"id":...}). The AI reports verified from the state of the domain. Synthetic case: the owner has not yet added the DNS records at their DNS host, so verified is false; the step then says the person adds the records and the check is run again.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
